en: Fixed `sparsePaths` plugin marketplaces cloning empty and replacing a working local copy on older git (before 2.39), which failed every refresh with "marketplace.json file is no longer present"
zh: 修复 `sparsePaths` plugin marketplace 在旧版 git（2.39 之前）上克隆为空并替换可用的本地副本，导致每次刷新都以 "marketplace.json file is no longer present" 失败的问题
